test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight persons – D, E, G, H, K, L, S and T are sitting in a straight line facing north. E sits second from the left end of the row. No one is sitting between H and E. G sits fourth to the right of H. K is sitting immediate left of G. Only two persons sit between K and D. L is sitting third to the right of S. How many persons are sitting between S and T?
solution:
**Given :** Eight persons – D, E, G, H, K, L, S and T are sitting in a straight line facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) E sits second from the left end of the row.

2) No one is sitting between H and E.

As position of E with respect to E is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for H.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acb97ee40b04684a4ad9946b2d0aafebf4ac27f4344c60afe40952c27a5f845f.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e60bfe26f43065d87d63dc84e079c101a584aeaa62d3c998a58ef9b4688892bc.png] 

3) G sits fourth to the right of H.

4) K is sitting immediate left of G.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7045b2610bf2cd5dcd23cef480a4a88525481eee6e43d3773a28dc87be250c11.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93d796c1bce1bfe5d2e005f9b047eef75e48e7400079652162a464ef414e984f.png] 

5) Only two persons sit between K and D.

6) L is sitting third to the right of S.

As there is possible position for D is case - (2), therefore case - (2) is eliminated.

After positioning D, L and S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T.

 
• Case - (1) :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e572dbbacffec6d30623da44ecdee815cc2c4cdd2052c911361f16f641ebbbd2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement four people i.e K, G, L and D are sitting between S and T.

Hence, "**More than three**" is the correct answer.
